notes: Hold your dictation shortcut, speak, and let go: Koegaki pastes your words where you are typing. With keyboard access the shortcut is Ctrl+Alt+K until you change it, and where your desktop has its own shortcut dialog you can set it there instead. Speech is recognized on this computer, and your voice and transcripts never leave it. English is the default. For Japanese, Chinese, Spanish and many more, choose Multilingual in Settings. Clean removes filler words, false starts and repeated words with a cleanup model that also runs on this computer. The model downloads on its own after the speech model, and waits while your connection is metered. Clean stays off until you turn it on in Settings or from the card on Home. When a new version is out, Koegaki offers it on Home. Install and restart closes Koegaki, asks for your password once, installs the new version and opens it. If Koegaki cannot install it itself, the card shows the download and the one command to install it yourself. Installing the package lets Koegaki press the paste keys for you. Reading your keyboard to notice your shortcut is asked for separately, with an administrator password, and only when you choose keyboard access. If you set the shortcut in your desktop's own shortcut dialog instead, Koegaki does not read your keyboard at all.
